component.name: DoubleRewardCard
component.description: Creative composite reward card that combines accumulated reward value with referral activation through a brand-green promo panel, gift icon, visible code, and share/copy action.

antiPatterns.scenario: A single static metric with no referral action
antiPatterns.reason: The component is designed as a behavior loop, not a simple stat card.
The activation subcard must keep one clear action.
antiPatterns.alternative: Choose copy or share as the primary action

contentRules: Use positive value framing such as 'Ya tienes 25€ acumulados'.
Show breakdown only when multiple rewards need explanation.
Keep referral code visible when active.
Current product design uses code + copy/share icon, not a text CTA.
The activation panel should feel promotional: brand greens, gift icon, and high-contrast referral code.

rules: The component is a stack of two subcards: Balance and Code.
In Figma, each variant must use a vertical Auto Layout root with Balance section and Referral promo panel as direct children.
Referral promo panel padding: vertical `layout/container/insetDense` (10px); horizontal matches balance subcard (`component/doubleRewardCard/balance/paddingX`).
Referral promo row: `spacing/4` (16px) horizontal gap between the gift column and promo copy (`component/doubleRewardCard/promoPanel/rowGap` on `musky-double-reward-card__promo` flex gap).
Referral promo panel uses Auto Layout for content and only decorative background shapes may be absolute-positioned.
Referral code pill must be a horizontal Auto Layout container with code text and copy/share icon.
When a visual value is not part of the global scale, bind it to component/doubleRewardCard/* instead of changing the design.

Compact mobile sizing must be controlled through component/doubleRewardCard/* tokens for balance padding, gift column width and icon sizing, code pill sizing, and title/subtitle gaps. The promo panel height follows content (no fixed min-height in layout).

Balance label ('Recompensas acumuladas') uses the same typography tokens as Action List row titles (`typography/body` + semibold); reward breakdown lines match Action List descriptions (`typography/bodySmall`).
Balance subcard is informational and not clickable.
Code subcard contains the single activation action: copy/share.
Use semantic surface/border and base radius for the outer card, brand green variables for the promo panel, and semantic/rewards/highlight/* for reward icon emphasis.
Do not move Header-specific accessibility documentation into this component; keep rewards reading-order annotations scoped to DoubleRewardCard.

layout.behavior: Vertical stack. Balance is always visible; breakdown is conditional; code/share action is the activation area.

accessibility.keyboardSupport: Share/copy action is a single focusable button. Balance subcard is not interactive.
accessibility.screenReader: Announce reward balance, optional breakdown, referral code, and share/copy action label.
accessibility.focusManagement: Focus lands only on the activation action when interactive.

aiHints.context: Use when the UI must both show accumulated reward value and invite the user to generate more rewards.
